svg.title: Request path: one HTTPS request from a client to a pod
svg.desc: The domainType in an app.yaml picks one of two branches. Public and media hosts (host.starktastic.net, host.benplus.app) enter through the external MetalLB address 10.9.8.90, the Service traefik and the Traefik entrypoint websecure. Internal hosts (host.internal.starktastic.net, the default) enter through the internal address 10.9.9.90, the Service traefik-internal and the entrypoint websec-int. Both entrypoints end TLS and run the middlewares strip-authentik-headers and hsts before any route. The route from the ingress chart then adds its own middlewares in order: crowdsec-bouncer on every public or media route, rate-limit-strong when rateLimit is true, and authentik-middleware when auth is true, or authentik-internal-gate when authAdmin is true. The request then reaches the app's Service and pod. The pod's volumes come from the storage class proxmox-retained, the storage class nfs-pv, or static NFS volumes.
svg.text: One HTTPS request, from client to pod
the default when app.yaml sets no domainType

svg.text: authentik-middleware is single sign-on. authentik-internal-gate is the admin-only outpost of ADR 0014; CI keeps it on internal routes.
